Name: Meadow Farm Style Paths and Flooring (CP)(AT)
Author: Gurrabird
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][CP] and [AT] versions of paths and flooring designed to coordinate with the look of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url]'s Meadow Farm house and other Meadow Farm style mods. Each type of craftable path has at least one texture and some have multiple options.  [/size][/color]


[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][u][AT] Alternative Textures: [/u][/b]
Download and install/unzip the [AT] version into your mods folder. Once installed, use the paint bucket to select textures and the paint brush to quickly spread along your path. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][u][CP] Content Patcher[/u][u]:[/u][/b]
Download and install/unzip the [CP] version into your mods folder. Once installed, any existing or newly installed craftable flooring or paths should have the default styles of this mod. If you have other Content Patcher path/flooring mods installed, you may need to select this one specifically, disable the others in the Generic Mod Config Menu or remove them from your mods folder.

[i]Customization options in the Generic Mod Config Menu:[/i][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select to disable any of the paths/flooring in this mod if you want to mix and match with other textures. Default setting is enabled for all.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select Variation: Choose which texture to use for path types that have more than one option.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Alternative Textures / Required only for AT version[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher / Required only for CP version [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits and appreciation:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lemurkat/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url] for the unique look of the Meadow Farmhouse that this is based on and permission to post this.[/color]
